steps: Boil and mash potato. Mix with spices. Prepare dough. Fill dough with potato mixture and cook on a hot pan.
Cook rice. Stir fry garlic, onion and vegetables. Add rice and soy sauce.
Boil pasta. Cook onion and garlic. Add tomato sauce and mix with pasta.
Marinate paneer and vegetables with yogurt and spices. Cook until lightly browned.
Beat eggs. Add vegetables and spices. Cook in a hot pan.
Add vegetables and cheese between bread slices. Toast until crisp.
Cook chickpeas. Prepare onion tomato masala. Add chickpeas and simmer.
Rinse poha. Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. Add onion and peanuts. Mix with poha.
Cook spinach and blend. Prepare masala. Add spinach and paneer and simmer.
Boil noodles. Stir fry vegetables. Add noodles and soy sauce.
Mash potato with onion and chilli. Spread on bread. Add cheese and toast.
Blend mango, milk, yogurt and sugar until smooth.
Mash banana. Mix with oats, milk and egg. Cook small pancakes on a pan.
Cook garlic and onion. Add mushrooms. Stir fry with soy sauce and pepper.
Cook lentils. Prepare garlic, onion and cumin tempering. Mix together.
Cook onion and spices. Add chicken and tomato. Cover and cook until done.
Cook chicken. Place chicken and vegetables between bread slices.
Cook chicken and vegetables. Add rice, egg and soy sauce. Stir fry.
Cook egg and vegetables. Add rice and soy sauce. Stir fry.
Cook vegetables with spices. Add rice and cook until fluffy.
Cook kidney beans. Prepare tomato onion masala. Add beans and simmer.
Boil vegetables. Mash them. Cook with onion, tomato, butter and spices.
Cook sprouts with spices. Prepare gravy and serve with pav and onion.
Prepare fermented batter from rice and urad dal. Steam in idli moulds.
Prepare dosa batter. Spread thinly on a hot pan and cook with oil.
Roast semolina. Temper spices and onion. Add water and semolina and cook.
Cook vegetables in water. Add pepper and salt. Simmer until vegetables are tender.
Mix egg, milk, sugar and cinnamon. Dip bread and cook on a pan.
Mix ingredients into batter. Cook small portions on a hot pan.
Chop fruits and mix together.
Blend milk, cocoa, sugar and ice cream.
